name: Liquid Moji Slider
description: Draggable emoji mood slider where a row of gooey dots swells into a face icon under the handle, and a speech bubble pops with the label when it settles.
contents: Row of clickable gooey dots, one per icon
Face icon that grows from the active dot
Speech bubble with the icon label and burst lines
behavior: Drag or click dots to move between icons, snapping to the nearest
Dots morph with a gooey blur filter and elastic easing
Speech bubble rotates in with elastic ease and a burst of lines on change
Slider scales to fit the container through an SVG viewBox

props.name: icons
props.default: 14 emoji faces with 32x32 SVG path data

editableByProps: Icons and their labels and SVG paths
Starting icon, dot spacing and swell size
fixed: Icon paths are designed on a 32x32 grid
Fills the viewport height with a background color; override with className
Initial index must be within the icons array
